For simple types like: boolean, integer, long and char. Tests implemented. TODO: When we try to set a variable value of an attribute in an object it calls Runtime.callFunctionOn and we don't support it yet. Fixes #42327.
Author: thaystg
Assignees: -

> TODO: When we try to set a variable value of an attribute in an object it calls Runtime.callFunctionOn and we don't support it yet.

We do support it - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/mono/wasm/debugger/BrowserDebugProxy/DevToolsHelper.cs#L207 . But maybe it is missing something that you need?

> > TODO: When we try to set a variable value of an attribute in an object it calls Runtime.callFunctionOn and we don't support it yet.
> 
> We do support it - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/mono/wasm/debugger/BrowserDebugProxy/DevToolsHelper.cs#L207 . But maybe it is missing something that you need?

I saw it but I didn't investigate why it was not working, it tries to run a function that receives the object as parameter and tries to run something like this: `this[attribute] = newValue`, do you think this should work?

See https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/mono/wasm/runtime/library_mono.js#L1227-L1249
You will need to implement - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/mono/wasm/runtime/library_mono.js#L1237

We construct a proxy object, so you would need a proxy setter there that does the actual value setting for managed code.
@thaystg thank you for making all the changes, and adding the tests!

What happens if you try to set `char` var with:

1. the value `abc`? Shouldn't that fail?
2. What if `abc` is another variable? Maybe for char we should require `'a'`? What do VS, and chrome do?

> What happens if you try to set `char` var with:
> 
> 1. the value `abc`? Shouldn't that fail?
> 2. What if `abc` is another variable? Maybe for char we should require `'a'`? What do VS, and chrome do?

1) Should fail, fixed.
2) It's required `'a'` on VS.

On Js even if I insert a value like this: `'a'` when I receive on debug proxy it's `"a"` so I'm just checking if the strlen is 1 otherwise I will return false.

review_comments: What we should to test? it's already testing res.IsOk.

Can we add tests for:

- async cases (static, and instance methods)?
- for primitives:
   - setting strings to null
   - trying to set null for setting non-string types
   - setting int32 value for a int8, etc

- in case of objects:
  - fields: static, instance, readonly
  - properties: static, instance(already have that)
  - unknown property name
  - invalid object id
  - setting a property with no setter
  - set a property that throws an exception
  - setting a property on a derived class instance, which has the setter in the base class, but overrides getter in the derived class
  - setting a property on a derived class instance, via a base class variable, where the derived class overrides the setter

- setting locals on a previous frame, step-check-value, step back to that method, check value
   - and the above for async also

- for primitive locals, can we add tests for all the supported types? You can use TheoryData, and a single test method to do that, so you don't have to lots of repeating.

- We would need tests for CFO types too, but that can be done later.
Can we open a issue to create more tests?
Sure, but maybe we can add the ones that check for correctness, or invalid inputs?
